explanation: Met Merrymakers at Shrovetide, Frans Hals, ca.1616–17, accession 14.40.605, Public Domain. Shrovetide before Lent with theatrical clowns named Pickled Herring and John Sausage. Curators identify central figure as a man dressed as a woman, describe bawdy double meanings; curator Adam Eaker on F.H. initials on beer tankard. Existing PR #3 Japanese prose refined only as needed for official wording; curation and identity unchanged.
